title: Women's Doubles Pair Change for World Junior Championships Trials
indian_angle: This update directly impacts the selection process for India's junior women's doubles team competing for a spot at the BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: An official announcement details a change in the women's doubles pair participating in the selection trials for the upcoming VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp Underway in Guwahati
indian_angle: This report covers the ongoing national coaching camp for India's U17 and U15 junior teams, crucial for their preparation for the Badminton Asia Junior Championships.
summary: The National Center of Excellence in Guwahati is hosting a coaching camp for the Indian U17 and U15 junior badminton teams, preparing them for the upcoming Badminton Asia Junior Championships 2026.

title: Final Selection Trials List Released for World Junior Championships
indian_angle: This news provides essential information on player eligibility and the list of Indian players who have qualified for the final selection trials for the BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released the player eligibility criteria and the list of qualified players for the final selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo, Egypt.

title: BAI Secretary Mishra Confident in India's Ability to Host Major Tournaments
indian_angle: BAI General Secretary Sanjay Mishra's statement highlights India's ambition and readiness to host prestigious international badminton events, including the BWF World Championships 2026.
summary: BAI General Secretary Sanjay Mishra expressed confidence in India's capability to host major international badminton tournaments, detailing the budget and ongoing renovation work for the BWF World Championships 2026 in Delhi.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Adopted for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This significant rule change in domestic junior tournaments directly impacts how young Indian badminton players will compete and develop.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for U-13, U-15, and U-17 categories in all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships.
